content:
Cultural Program (Kala Sandhya)

Time: 03:00 PM - 05:00 PM

Venue: Open Air Auditorium Stage

Coordinator: Arts Club & Cultural Committee

Vibrant traditional Kerala music, dance, Thiruvathira, and drama performances presented by students and faculty.

Programs

Thiruvathirakali

03:00 PM - 03:30 PM

Traditional circular dance performed by female students around a lit Nilavilakku.

Onapattu & Music Concert

03:30 PM - 04:15 PM

Festive Onam songs and classical musical renditions by the college band.

Folk Dance & Drama

04:15 PM - 05:00 PM

Skit and fusion dance performances celebrating Mahabali and Onam legends.
